summary: Updates RFC 5247 to define how an EAP Session-Id is derived for several authentication methods. It fills a gap for EAP-SIM and EAP-AKA when a fast reconnect is used instead of full authentication, and also clarifies the derivation for other methods including PEAP.

eli5.summary: When you rejoin a network quickly after a short break, both sides need the same name for your session. This explains how to work out that name for a few login methods.
